newsitem.title: UK: RANK, BRITISH LAND PLAN PROPERTY JV.
newsitem.headline: RANK, BRITISH LAND PLAN PROPERTY JV.

text.p: Rank Group Plc and The British Land Company Plc announced a 100 million stg 50/50 property joint venture on Thursday.
Under the agreement, British Land will buy leisure properties to be leased back to Rank at open market values. The exact number of properties to be bought and the payments have yet to be finalised.

Andrew Teare, Rank's chief executive, said in a statement: "We see the joint venture as an opportunity to obtain funding for our leisure developments, current and future, in a way that retains an interest in future value and provides flexibility in terms of the group's expansion plans for leisure activities."
Rank said it would improve the return on capital employed.
British land chairman John Ritblat said he welcomed the deal.
